title: 第659章 被天罚了吧第658章 一众古氏族的人情
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
巫殇嘴角勾起一抹桀骜冷笑，眼底傲气滔天：“魔族和妖族，我本就有心去历练一番，但我巫族修士，傲骨天成，绝不能被小辈拿捏使唤，这脸面，我们丢不起！”
巫翎深深看了他一眼，忍不住提醒：“你切莫肆意妄为，天道誓言高悬九天，一旦违背，牵连全族，谁也承受不起后果！”
可这番叮嘱，根本入不了巫殇的耳。
他自幼天赋异禀，心性高傲，狂傲不羁，不到两千岁，便修至入圣巅峰第二重境界，只差一步，便可踏入准帝之境。
这般耀眼的天赋，放眼整个玄黄界，都是万年难遇的天才。
这也造就了他心高气傲，目空一切的性格。
在他看来，自身天赋逆天，本就得天道眷顾，区区天道誓言，根本束缚住不了他。
巫殇不再理会巫翎，径直迈步上前，居高临下地站在云星落面前。
他身形挺拔，眼神鄙夷、姿态傲慢，如同俯瞰蝼蚁的神明，死死盯着眼前的少女。
“就是你，激活了各族镇族至宝？”巫殇语气淡漠，带着毫不掩饰的轻视。
云星落神色平静，不卑不亢，轻轻点头：“正是晚辈，前辈有何指教？”
“指教不敢当。”
巫殇嗤笑一声，语气冰冷强势，“我只有两个要求。第一，立刻归还从我巫族、雷族手中骗走的镇族至宝。第二，我等二十名入圣大能，不会陪你们这群小辈前往魔界，更不会受你们拿捏使唤。”
这番话直白又嚣张，丝毫没有将天道誓言和之前的约定放在眼里。
云星落眼底瞬间掠过一抹冷冽寒芒。
她早就料到，一众高傲自大的古族大能，在各族族长离去，无人制衡之后，必定心生不服，想要反悔耍赖。
她抬手取出温热的天道人情母卡，握在掌心，语气清冷：“此事是你族族长亲自立下的天道誓言，一诺千金。我救了你族全员性命，你们出手相助一次，等价交换，公道至极。前辈这是打算违背誓言，出尔反尔？”
巫殇闻言，像是听到了天大的笑话，仰头狂笑一声，周身威压骤然暴涨，霸道绝伦。
“天道？公道？”
他眼神凌厉，杀气外露，字字狂妄：“在绝对的实力面前，天道也算个屁！这世间从来没有什么公道，强者，就是最大的规矩！”

全场气氛瞬间降至冰点，剑拔弩张，一触即发。
夜葬、霍小棠、叶凌霜三人瞬间绷紧心神，周身灵力悄然运转，随时准备应战。
云星落眸光彻底变冷，静静直视着巫殇：“那前辈想如何？”
巫殇负手而立，傲气滔天，语气带着极致的压迫感：“我话只说一遍，给你百息时间考虑。乖乖交出至宝，自行褪去随行约定，此事作罢。”
“若是百息之后，你不肯依从，那就休怪我等出手，强行夺取！”
面对一名入圣大能的强势逼迫，云星落没有半分退让，身形挺拔如松，声音清冷坚定，响彻整片山谷。
“既然前辈执意如此，那动手便是。”
短短一句话，平静却带着刺骨的冷意，丝毫没有被入圣大能的威压震慑半分。
巫殇闻言，瞬间勃然大怒，眼底戾气暴涨，满脸都是难以置信的愠怒。
他堂堂巫族千年不遇的绝世天才，距离准帝仅有一步之遥的入圣巅峰强者，亲自放话施压，区区一个化神小辈，竟然敢如此硬气顶撞，半点不知退让。
“冥顽不灵，既然你找死，那本座便成全你！”
content_en:
The corners of Wu Shang's lips curled up into a sneer, and his eyes were full of arrogance: "I have the intention to experience the demons and monsters, but as a monk of the Wu clan, I am proud and innate, and I must not be manipulated by juniors. We cannot afford to lose our face!"
Wu Ling took a deep look at him and couldn't help but remind him: "Don't act recklessly. The oath of heaven is upheld for nine days. Once it is violated, the whole clan will be implicated, and no one can bear the consequences!"
But these instructions could not reach Wu Shang's ears at all.
He has been gifted with extraordinary talents since childhood, and has an arrogant and unruly nature. Before he was two thousand years old, he had reached the second level of the peak of sainthood. He was only one step away from entering the realm of quasi-emperor.
Such a dazzling talent, looking at the entire Xuanhuang world, is a genius that is rarely seen in thousands of years.
This also created his arrogant and arrogant character.
In his opinion, his talent is beyond the pale and he is already favored by heaven. A mere oath of heaven cannot restrain him at all.
Wu Shang ignored Wu Ling and stepped forward, standing condescendingly in front of Yun Xingluo.
He was tall and tall, with contemptuous eyes and arrogant posture, like a god overlooking ants, staring at the girl in front of him.
"Is it you who activated the treasures of all clans?" Wu Shang's tone was indifferent, with undisguised contempt.
Yun Xingluo's expression was calm, neither humble nor arrogant, and nodded gently: "It's this junior. What advice do you have, senior?"
"Don't take advice seriously."
Wu Shang sneered and said in a cold and forceful tone, "I only have two demands. First, immediately return the treasure of the town that was defrauded from my Witch Clan and Thunder Clan. Second, I and the twenty saintly masters will not accompany you juniors to the Demon Realm, let alone be manipulated by you."
These words were straightforward and arrogant, and did not take the oath of heaven and the previous agreement into consideration at all.
A flash of cold light flashed across Yun Xingluo's eyes.
She had long expected that the arrogant and arrogant ancient clan leaders would definitely feel dissatisfied and want to regret and cheat after the clan leaders left.
She raised her hand and took out the warm Mother Card of Heavenly Dao, held it in the palm of her hand, and said in a cold tone: "This matter is the Heavenly Dao oath made by the leader of your clan himself, a promise worth a thousand gold. I saved the lives of all your clan members, and you help me once. It is an equal exchange, and it is extremely fair. Senior, are you planning to break your oath and go back on your words?"
When Wu Shang heard this, he looked up and laughed wildly, as if he had heard a big joke. The pressure around him suddenly increased, and he was extremely domineering.
"The way of heaven? Justice?"
His eyes were sharp, his murderous intent was exposed, and his words were arrogant: "In the face of absolute strength, the way of heaven is nothing! There is no justice in this world. The strongest is the biggest rule!"
The atmosphere in the whole place instantly dropped to freezing point, and the situation was tense and on the verge of breaking out.
Ye Zang, Huo Xiaotang, and Ye Lingshuang immediately tensed up their minds, and their spiritual power circulated quietly, ready to fight at any time.
Yun Xingluo's eyes turned completely cold, and he looked directly at Wu Shang quietly: "What do you want, senior?"
Wu Shang stood with his hands behind his back, arrogant to the sky, and his tone was extremely oppressive: "I will only say it once, and I will give you a hundred breaths to think about it. Hand over the treasure obediently, and cancel the agreement to accompany you. Let this matter be over."
"If you refuse to comply after a hundred breaths, then don't blame me for taking action and taking it by force!"
Facing the strong persecution of a saintly powerful man, Yun Xingluo did not give in at all. His figure was as tall as a pine, and his voice was cold and firm, resounding throughout the valley.
"Since senior insists on doing this, then take action."
In just one sentence, he was calm but with a biting coldness, and was not at all intimidated by the pressure of the saintly power.
When Wu Shang heard this, he became furious instantly, his eyes filled with rage, and his face was filled with unbelievable sullenness.
He was a peerless genius that the Witch Clan had not seen for thousands of years, a peak saint who was only one step away from the quasi-emperor. He personally put pressure on him. A mere junior incarnation of gods dared to contradict him so hard without giving in at all.
"Stubborn, since you are seeking death, then I will becomeAll you! "
